cover: Signs your business has outgrown its spreadsheets

slides.title: The same status lives in three places
slides.body: An auction house we built for kept inventory in spreadsheets, a photo folder and a group chat. Over time the three stopped agreeing.

slides.title: Nobody can say who changed it, or when
slides.body: A spreadsheet shows where an item is. It can't show who moved it or when, so a disagreement has nothing to settle it.

slides.title: Deleting the wrong row means it's gone
slides.body: One mistake the week before a sale, and someone has to rebuild the record from memory.

slides.title: Real work happens in a chat thread
slides.body: Decisions made in the group chat never make it back into any record.

slides.title: What we built instead
slides.body: One record per item through seven stages, from intake to sold. Every change is recorded against a person, and deletes can be undone.

slides.title: AI drafts, a person approves
slides.body: Photos go in and catalog copy comes out. A cataloger reads and approves every draft before it reaches the inventory.
